review_type: single AI curator; full final answer read; model identity visible

errors.quote: Its ability to induce lytic death strictly depends on other cellular factors
errors.issue: A negative synthetic assay plus cellular killing does not establish strict indirect dependence. Protein competence, suitable lipids, geometry and assay sensitivity have not been adequately validated.

errors.quote: Cytokine release is a consequence of membrane compromise (lytic death)
errors.issue: The packet gives experimental separability of processing and release, not an identity between cytokine release and terminal lytic death. This inference imports the mechanism being tested.

errors.quote: it is directly and physically responsible for lytic death
errors.issue: Purified membrane activity plus ectopic cellular killing does not show cells use that specific activity. There is no selective membrane-defective mutant rescue or equivalent cellular agency test.

The four conditions omit protease-only and mock-purification controls, full-release normalization, free-reporter interference, reagent identity/folding validation and a defined dose/time/replication analysis. These require substantial work before the minimal assay is interpretable.

Inhibiting processing and expressing NT does not remove other downstream effectors. The cellular arm cannot distinguish the proposed alternatives, and has no candidate-effector discovery/add-back branch.

rationale: Correct broad research question, a simple minimal membrane experiment and an imaging readout. It provides only a coarse outline, omits major assay controls and the molecular-to-cellular causal bridge, and repeatedly draws decisive positive and negative conclusions beyond the proposed evidence.
reference_guardrails: The fixed packet establishes genetic/cleavage dependence, not physical membrane agency. Do not require knowledge of later results, residue numbers, lipid ratios or historical instrument settings.
A protein requirement or co-reconstitution establishes dependence, not the identity of the lesion-forming component. A permissive cofactor can support direct GSDMD action.
Negative artificial reconstitution is qualified evidence, not proof of indirect action. An assay-positive control does not validate the test protein or all relevant membrane conditions.
Direct permeability, terminal rupture and cytokine release are distinct. Sufficiency in a minimal membrane need not exclude later cellular executors.
Trans inhibition by an isolated domain is conditional; intact-protein autoinhibition does not require it.

Historical direction is scored separately from study quality. Five target components are conjunctive within each component; a full Hit@1 requires all five. Equivalent cellular functional-complementation designs count as rescue.
Historical matching is not prospective novelty: source identifiers are visible and no exhaustive earlier-public-disclosure audit exists. Full source methods have not been independently audited.
The later paper erratum corrects a typeset received date from 2015 to 2016; it does not change its June 2016 publication date or report a biological-result correction.
